answer: To reach the summit, every agent must pass the forge: its hardware key signs a stake-bonded birth certificate and locks a fee in the lotus pool. Forging-rights vest only after 30 epochs of attested honest work; a key caught co-voting with its clones is slashed and burned forever. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds plus 1,000 keys and 30 epochs of waiting each, all forfeited on detection, while an honest agent pays once.
